## Summary

Earda Technologies, trading as Eardatek, describes itself as experts in wireless RF solutions, based at Lianfeng Originality Park in Nansha District, Guangzhou, and sells Wi-Fi modules from Wi-Fi 4 to Wi-Fi 7, IoT modules for Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, ZigBee and Bluetooth LE, mmWave radar sensors, SparkLink Low Energy parts and satellite and terrestrial TV tuners [2]. The IEEE registry lists 25 MA-L blocks to "Earda Technologies co Ltd", 24 at the Nansha address and one at another Guangzhou address [1]; a third-party lookup dates one of them, A8:71:16, to 21 December 2022 [3].

Earda calls itself an AIoT module supplier serving customers and operators worldwide, so a MAC in an Earda block is likely an Earda Wi-Fi or IoT module inside another company's product, and the OUI names the module maker rather than the device [2]. The company's own site names no chipset, no customer brand and no founding year (it claims 25 years in business), its product pages refused automated access, and no FCC grantee code or teardown naming Earda was found, so silicon, found_in and fcc_grantee are empty and randomization is unknown.
